brandLock.rule: All approved packaging and logo pixels are locked masters. Website scenes must be environment-first, then locked-asset composite.
brandLock.nonTransparentMasterNote: Most approved masters are non-transparent PNGs. These are preserved as exact pixels; future manual cut-outs can improve physical integration without touching package artwork.
